scope: Complete retained rigid closing proof extended over every changed core and rear-equipment body. The current extension uses complete physical quadrant STLs and continuous triangle-distance intervals. The suction elbow and cross-parent tube ends are connected through the open funnel aperture after the rear approach.

baseline.method: Complete translation intervals certified from triangle-surface distances using the 1-Lipschitz translation bound. Broad-phase separation uses complete swept AABBs. Any surface contact or unresolved interval remains a witness for native follow-up. Cross-parent tubes and the loose pump inlet elbow are connected after closure through the funnel opening, per the accepted rotating-joint assembly sequence. This does not infer flexible handling or printed force.

assembly_prerequisites.instruction: Keep the pump suction elbow and the quarter-inch pump-inlet link loose during approach. Clock and connect their round joints through the uncovered funnel aperture after closure. The V-K elbow remains with back-top.
assembly_prerequisites.scope: This is the accepted loose-joint assembly order, not a rigid-motion or flexible-handling proof for a fully connected pump handoff.

front_cleanup.scope: Subtractive cleanup only. The removed stock is above the pump bearing shoulders and outside the snap receiver floors; the continuous front closing proof therefore remains conservative.

limits: Nominal surface separation does not qualify printed rail force, flexible lead handling or support release.
The unchanged pipe handoffs and flexible reservoir tails retain the named free-end staging in the assembly procedure.
added_root_scope: The current added-root material fits inside the already checked complete approach box.

retained_motion_mesh_binding.scope: Every other named rigid body in the complete closing review retains exact position and triangle-index bytes. The two stock changes are bound separately by their native material differences.

final_changed_pair_extension.scope: Continuous changed-pair extension of the retained complete closing proof. Unchanged movers, floor/base and source-identical printed stations retain their bound baseline. The lowered pump group, shifted water inlet, altered lid/cup and clockwise Y-A elbow are covered here. The pump suction elbow and its short inlet link are loose during rear approach; cross-parent flexible tube ends are connected after closure. This records nominal rigid motion, not printed force or flexible handling.

roof_stock_change_base_separation.basis: The sole back-top changes are its PSU well, boss faces and blind pilots. Their added material is at or above Z346.7. All cuts remove stock. This region is vertically separated from the complete base throughout the Y slide.

final_changed_pair_extension.pair_record_scope: Complete swept AABB exclusions are counted; every pair needing continuous distance intervals is recorded below.
